decision-doctrine-before-orders.title: Normalize human intent into Doctrine before execution orders
decision-doctrine-before-orders.content: Freeform human directives and supporting artifacts are preserved as source input, then normalized into versioned Doctrine before Campaign Plans, Operations, and Project Arm Orders are produced.

design-project-arm-hierarchy.title: Dreadnought Task Group Project Arm Agent hierarchy
design-project-arm-hierarchy.content: Working execution hierarchy is Dreadnought to Task Group to Project Arm to Agent. Project Arms receive compartmentalized Orders rather than project-wide strategic context by default.

design-explicit-creative-authority.title: Creative agency is explicit and scoped
design-explicit-creative-authority.content: Doctrine and Orders use a bounded creative-authority envelope so useful agent discretion can be high, medium, low, approval-required, or prohibited by domain without silently widening authority.

implementation-doctrine-campaign-orders.title: Doctrine Campaign Plan and Order models implemented
implementation-doctrine-campaign-orders.content: PR 3 branch introduces typed Doctrine, CampaignPlan, Operation, and Order models plus CLI commands and tests. This is a substrate only; semantic normalization, automatic PR creation, source ingest, Grapher control-plane writes, and policy enforcement remain deferred.

decision-grapher-ci-gate.title: Every repository change must update Grapher
decision-grapher-ci-gate.content: CI rejects any pull request or direct main-branch commit that does not modify both .grapher/knowledge.json and .grapher/history.jsonl. Grapher maintenance is therefore a required property of the change path rather than an optional contributor convention.

evidence.summary: Documentation provenance and Grapher CI enforcement

design-code-linked-architecture-docs.title: Architecture and process diagrams are code-addressable
design-code-linked-architecture-docs.content: Dreadnought documentation now has a root architecture map plus subsystem architecture diagrams. Architecture nodes identify implementation paths, and process nodes in architecture-bearing documents identify code paths together with inception and current commit provenance.

evidence.summary: Diagram standard requires code-linked architecture and process diagrams
CI tests enforce architecture document structure and process-node provenance

knowledge-cli-usage-guide.title: CLI usage is documented for humans and agents
knowledge-cli-usage-guide.content: The Dreadnought CLI has a shared operational guide covering installation, help, Mission/Doctrine/Campaign/Order lifecycle commands, protocol ingestion, Project Arm dispatch, scratch requirements, adapter tokens, exit-code semantics, authority boundaries, and links to the implementation files that define executable behavior.

decision-always-use-grapher.title: Every repository change must use Grapher
decision-always-use-grapher.content: Agents and humans must use the repository-supported Grapher mutation path for every substantive repository change. Hand-authored Grapher evidence or pass-record files are not a substitute for invoking Grapher. A valid change must mutate canonical .grapher/knowledge.json and append .grapher/history.jsonl through Grapher, then publish any required shared evidence.

evidence.summary: Repository invariant requiring actual Grapher use
CI requires canonical graph and history mutation
